$comment: EXAMPLE_ONLY - an illustrative STATE_MANIFEST_V1 instance, not current repository state. Every hash, number and name below is a fabricated placeholder. Never read this file as proof of anything; compile a real manifest from live git and gh output instead. The fixture deliberately shows both halves of the proof-pairing rule: pr_number, pr_state, review_threads_unresolved and claude_capacity are null because their evidence says UNKNOWN, while the remaining registered fields carry values because their evidence says PROVEN.
compiled_at_evidence: EXAMPLE_ONLY placeholder. A real manifest records the exact commands run, for example 'git rev-parse HEAD', 'git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}', 'gh pr list --state open --json number'.

authorization.notes: merge_authorized is structurally always false. Merge authority is HUMAN_ONLY_PER_PR, granted per PR and per head at the moment of merge, and never carried in state.
